remote-fetch-exec: Fetches remote code and runs it
  Severity:    critical
  Confidence:  confirmed
  Ecosystems:  wp-plugin, wp-theme, composer, npm

Why it matters
  A release that shows remote-fetch-exec can change what runs on every request
  of your site. This text stands in for the detect lane's explain YAML, which
  the release links.

How to review
  1. Open the flagged file at the line the finding names and read the code
     around it, including what calls it.
  2. Compare with the changelog.

False alarms
  A vendored library can show the same pattern.

Incidents
  Example 2024: a plugin sold to a new owner shipped remote-fetch-exec.

More
  https://github.com/RhythmShahriar/rhythm/wiki/Sightread-Signal-Reference#remote-fetch-exec
